title: Destructure props, and keep the curlies

slides.say: You rarely need the whole props object. So you destructure it, right in the function signature.
Curly braces inside the parentheses pull out person and size. It is the same as reading them from props.
Watch out. Without the curly braces, person is the whole props object, and size is not a prop at all.

slides.text: function Avatar({ person, size }) — braces inside parentheses.
slides.say: Takeaway: curly braces inside the parentheses. Every time.
